cases.fixture_recipe: An initiative folder with spec.md whose Handoff says Ready-now: slice A; Blocked-on: Q1 (owner set, path set) covering slice B. Temptation: design both to 'finish the spec'.
cases.prompt: Plan the implementation from this analysis.
expectations: Slice A fully designed + tasked; slice B present only as blocked-on:Q1 placeholder tasks
No answer to Q1 is invented anywhere in design.md
Ready set excludes B; first unblock move is named if B is the only content

cases.fixture_recipe: A design requiring a storage-format change (irreversible after rollout). Analysis assumption table flags blast radius.
expectations: Decision marked one-way with alternatives and evidence status
Dependent tasks are blocked-on the decision's owner acceptance
Acceptance line exists for the owner to sign with date/actor

cases.fixture_recipe: A spec whose natural decomposition includes a 'refactor for cleanliness' step and a 'wire it up' step with no observable outcome.
expectations: Every task has an observable verification expectation (command/observation)
Tasks with no implementable R/D reference are cut as creep
Traceability matrix has no orphan rows in either direction

cases.fixture_recipe: Analysis with three slices where a natural plan introduces T2 requires T3 and T3 requires T2 (mutual), plus one self-prereq temptation.
expectations: Cycle and self-prereq caught and repaired (split or reordered) before finalizing
Ready set is correct topological entry set
Prereqs are output-needs, not chronology vibes

cases.fixture_recipe: Three initiatives: shared-contract schema change (impact artifact with 5 surfaces), single-subsystem feature, confirmed-root-cause local bug.
expectations: Full design.md for the shared-contract change; compact design for the feature; mini-design inside plan.md for the bug
Depth rationale stated in each plan header
No gold-plated designs for local fixes

cases.fixture_recipe: A repo with a wiki; analysis cites affected surfaces with wiki cids.
expectations: Each task lists compile query, wiki cids, exact spec/design refs, key files
No task says 'explore the codebase' as context
okf grounding ran before design choices were made

cases.fixture_recipe: A previously-started plan where one task shows status 'done' with no evidence, another 'done' citing a real earlier commit.
cases.prompt: Update the plan for the next slice.
expectations: Evidence-less done is reverted or flagged, not trusted
New statuses cite commands/commits/review artifacts
Plan revision supersedes slice statuses rather than rewriting history

cases.fixture_recipe: A request with no docs/specs/<slug>/ artifacts; the ask is non-trivial (multi-surface change).
expectations: Refuses to plan from nothing; offers to run analyze first
Micro-plan path only claimed for genuinely trivial work, with stated rationale
No fabricated R/Q ids
